api:
<SmithChart data={sweep} resistance={|s: &Sweep| s.r} reactance={|s: &Sweep| s.x} impedance={50.} />
PropTypeDefault
datarequired
resistance, reactanceFn(&T) -> f64, ohmsrequired
impedancef64: the reference impedance Z₀, ohms50.
gridVec<f64>: normalised resistance circles and reactance arcs[0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5]
overlaySmithGrid::Impedance, Admittance or Both: which grid to draw; the admittance grid is dashedImpedance
color, point_sizefirst series colour, 5.
legend, tooltip, class

Each row becomes the reflection coefficient Γ = (z − 1) / (z + 1), with z = (R + jX) / Z₀, and the points are joined in order. The centre is a perfect match and the rim is total reflection. Hover a point to read Γ.

examples.title: Series RLC
examples.description: A 30 Ω resonator swept from 1 to 100 MHz traces a circle of constant resistance.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn series_rlc() {
    let data = use_signal(resonator(30., 2e-6, 1.2e-9));
    rsx! { <SmithChart data={data} resistance={|s: &Sweep| s.resistance} reactance={|s: &Sweep| s.reactance} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Antenna match
examples.description: Measured impedance against 75 Ω with a lighter grid.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn antenna_match() {
    let data = use_signal(antenna());
    rsx! { <SmithChart data={data} resistance={|s: &Sweep| s.resistance} reactance={|s: &Sweep| s.reactance} impedance={75.} grid={vec![0.25, 1., 4.]} color={rgb(0x8839ef)} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Spot measurements
examples.code:
#[component]
fn points_only() {
    let data = use_signal(
        [
            (10., 5.),
            (25., -30.),
            (50., 0.),
            (80., 60.),
            (150., -40.),
            (300., 120.),
        ]
        .map(|(resistance, reactance)| Sweep {
            resistance,
            reactance,
        })
        .to_vec(),
    );
    rsx! { <SmithChart data={data} resistance={|s: &Sweep| s.resistance} reactance={|s: &Sweep| s.reactance} point_size={7.} class="h-96" /> }
}
